title: Chapter 350
text:
After playing with the armor for a while, the players remembered to compare the attributes of the Sunil Enlistee Armor with the ones in the shop, and they realized that the difference was not much.
Same quality, one-third of the price. This was the conscience of the industry!
Everyone was overjoyed. The remaining people stopped watching and willingly took out their money, transferring it to Han Xiao's account.
"More than fifty people, more than 40,000 Enas. About enough to buy two knowledges …"
Han Xiao chuckled. This was not the end yet!
Then, he opened up a new business in the faction store interface — equipment enhancement!
When Han Xiao was creating the armor, the attributes of the armor he created could be called the 'basic version'. This was to leave room for improvement so that he could carry out his enhancement business!
Repair and enhancement were long-term income. Han Xiao had many mechanical enhancement skills, so he had the prerequisite to carry out the enhancement business. How could Han Xiao miss out on such an income generating business? Not only that, he also had to control his strength during the enhancement. He would not go all out on the first enhancement and always leave room for improvement. Only then would he be able to attract the players to continue spending.
One could not blame the great mechanic Han Xiao for being black-hearted. Splitting an item into several batches for sale could maximize the profit, and at the same time, the players who did not know about it would be willing. Han Xiao used the cheap and good quality equipment to compete with the other shops. First, he would make the players buy the equipment and fall into the trap. Then, he would introduce the subsequent additional business, turning a one-time sale into a long-term profit.
After all, he had occasionally played standalone games in his previous life and had been inspired by the idea of selling the game in pieces.
Han Xiao sighed. Back then, I was also an honest person when I was young. My young and pure heart was tainted by society. It is not the man's fault that I became bad, but the world's fault …
In the next few days, Han Xiao rushed to make all the armor. Every player changed their appearance and put on the Enlistee Armor. It was like a mercenary group had a set of uniforms. Although the players were all Supers, the Enlistee Class Armor also provided some convenience.
As a staunch supporter of the great mechanic Han, Frenzied Sword was the first to spend money to strengthen the armor. After strengthening, the attributes of the armor increased by about ten percent, and the price of strengthening the same piece of equipment kept increasing. The first strengthening of the Enlistee Armor only cost 60 Enas, the second 100, and the third 150. With every three strengthening, the price would increase by leaps and bounds. The fourth strengthening cost 300 Enas, and so on …
Every strengthening would increase the attributes of the armor by eight to twelve percent. The price was low, and the benefits were high. Frenzied Sword set an example, and the others felt that it was reliable and followed suit. After the Sunil mission, the players all had tens of thousands of Enas in their pockets, and they would not feel comfortable if they did not splurge.
The space that Han Xiao left for strengthening the armor was too large, and he would need to strengthen it at least seven times to reach the peak of his ability. The strengthening business brought him a total of 23,000 Enas, which meant that more than fifty players had strengthened it more than three times on average!
Selling the armor for more than 40,000 Enas, and the subsequent strengthening earned another 23,000 Enas. Han Xiao now had more than 76,000 Enas in his account, which was more than enough to buy knowledge.
While he was happily selling, Herlous found Han Xiao and asked with surprise, "How do you know about our Enlistee Armor technology?"
Building the Sunil armor himself would definitely attract Herlous' suspicion. Han Xiao laughed and said, "I derived your blueprints when I was repairing the battlefield. Isn't it amazing?"
Herlous' face twitched. He had secretly learned Sunil technology, and a Sunil still praised him for being amazing. Even his Battleship Slicing Blade could not cut through such thick skin!
However, the Sunil was already in such a state, so why would he care about this? Herlous still wanted to work together with Han Xiao, so he did not care about this. Furthermore, this was not a very precious technology. Most civilizations had basic Enlistee Armor, and their styles were all different.
…
Juberly Hub, the regional exchange …
Han Xiao had earned enough money, so he immediately went to buy Promotion Knowledge. The Class Advancement requirement that he had been stuck on for so long was about to be completed, and he was a little excited.
There were only eight Mechanic Promotion Knowledges in the Colton Star Cluster. Han Xiao glanced at them and immediately chose two Promotion Knowledges.
[Heavy Machinery Modification], price twenty-five!
[Advanced Electromagnetism], price thirty-seven!
Learning … Learning successful! You have learned [Heavy Machinery Modification]!
Learning … Learning successful! You have learned [Advanced Electromagnetism]!
Class Advancement Requirements: Total Level 80, 400 INT, five Mechanic Promotion Knowledges mastered.
Class Advancement Successful!
Detected that the level 80 Promotion Mission has been completed!
Promotion successful! END bonus increased. 1 END = 40 HP = 50 Stamina!]
You have received a new Class [Data Mechanic v1]. + 100 Energy, + 3 DEX, + 2 END, + 4 INT. You have received 5 Free Attribute Points. You have received 1 Potential Point.
You have learned the skill [Blueprint Improvement]!
You have learned the skill [High Concentration Refinement]!
You have learned the skill [Magnetic Vision — Data Flow]!
You have learned the talent [Machinery Analytical Comprehension]!
The energy in his body cheered and jumped. With the double increase in Class Advancement and Promotion, Han Xiao felt that some kind of shackle had been broken. His vision turned black, and it felt like a few hours had passed, but in reality, it had only been half a second. His vision became clear again, but there was a huge change. He could feel more subtle things.
Every time his strength increased, he felt like he was reborn.
A Data Mechanic was also known as a Senior Mechanic. Their understanding of machinery had reached a whole new level, and their Machinery Affinity at this stage would greatly increase. Of the four new abilities, [Magnetic Vision — Data Flow] and [Machinery Analytical Comprehension] were both abilities that could greatly increase one's Machinery Affinity.
Machinery Affinity was the core attribute of the Mechanic class. It represented the speed, attributes, and power of the Mechanic when building and using machinery. [Magnetic Vision — Data Flow] was an active ability. After activating it, he would enter a special magnetic vision, and his own magnetic energy would become an extended sense, allowing him to feel the details of the machinery.
Han Xiao directly raised this ability to Lv.10, and the effect was that it would consume 20 Energy every minute, increasing his Machinery Affinity by 25% to 50%. The increase would fluctuate every second, completely random. Because the energy consumption was low, this ability could be activated for a long time. Different from [Surging Mechanical Force], which could only increase damage, this ability could be used in building.
[Machinery Analytical Comprehension] was a talent. Intelligence would directly increase his Machinery Affinity, and the effect was very impressive. Every 10 Intelligence points would increase his Machinery Affinity by 1%. Han Xiao currently had more than 400 Intelligence points. This was the key ability at this stage. Increasing the Intelligence attribute was very beneficial to the Mechanic class. In the long run, this was a very core ability of the Mechanic class.
[High Concentration Refining] was the upgraded version of [Basic Refining]. It increased the strength of the raw materials, and the effect was very important. [Blueprint Improvement] was a passive ability. When building equipment, there was a chance of activating the effect. The level of the equipment blueprint would be temporarily increased by no more than three levels, increasing the attributes of the product. There was also a chance of a 'critical hit' during the manufacturing process, creating equipment of a higher grade. The chance depended on Intelligence and Luck.
Han Xiao still had more than 2.5 billion experience. With a wave of his hand, he directly raised these abilities to the maximum level, spending close to 50 million experience. Then, Han Xiao immediately raised his main class to the max level of V15.
Above LV 80, the experience required for leveling up increased exponentially. One level required tens of millions of experience, and leveling up to 15 levels in an instant cost 900 million experience. He did not even blink.
[Data Mechanic] leveled up to V15 (x). + 240 Energy, + 3 DEX, + 2 END, + 4 INT. Received 5 Free Attribute Points. Received 1 Potential Point.]
He directly went from LV 80 to LV 95! It even exceeded the upper limit of the players in Version 2.0!
Han Xiao's lead further expanded.
The strength that filled his body suddenly swelled and became vigorous. If it was a small stream before, it was now like a wide river!
Han Xiao took a deep breath and felt the strength of his body. He noticed that his energy had undergone an obvious transformation. He opened the interface and threw all his Free Attribute Points into Intelligence. He then observed the drastic changes in his attributes.
Level: 95
Main Class: Mechanic
STR 121, DEX 244, END 214, INT 570, MYS 21, CHA 14, LUK 1
Free Attribute Points: 0
Potential Points: 82
Health: 13057
Stamina: 15420
[Energy: 5210 [V9]]
Energy Rank: 5377 Ona
Grade: B
You are a sufficiently powerful Super. You are also one of the main forces in the galaxy. Having evolved to this stage, you can look down on most creatures.
"As expected, my grade has reached B class!" Han Xiao was overjoyed. Just my health alone has increased by more than 5,000 points, and my energy has reached a new level. My overall strength should be forty percent higher than before!
He had finally crossed the threshold of Grade B, and he had a certain level of self-protection. His combat ability was far beyond that of Grade B. Now that he had obtained two new Advanced Knowledges, his combat style could be upgraded!
The sense of fulfilment filled Han Xiao's heart.
